correctness.rationale: For each minimum cyclic gap d, the blocked configuration B_t has only two possible neighbors outside the already-forced lower-gap layer; one is A_(t-1), the other A_t. All nonzero permitted off-diagonal weights yield unique continuation. Distinct sources under each pair annihilator ensure loss-dark implies vanishing on the initial set. Direct state-graph code checked 35 cases and 7,633 boundary equations; no finite check replaces proof.
